recommendation.summary: dsh-better-sidebar@0.24.1 is a Web-plane DSH plugin (dsh.client.platform=web in both source and published manifests) that adds a right sidebar with file tree, editor, changes, tasks and side chat, and exposes a service for other plugins to register sidebar tabs and file viewers. Bounded evidence supports only the Web surface: plugin CI packs the tarball, mounts it through the official `dsh plugin --profile web add` channel into a real DSH instance, and headlessly renders the DSH web UI with Playwright Chromium. No plugin-owned SDK, ACP, headless or interactive-TUI workflow is evidenced, so executionProfiles is [web] only. Node: engines.node is ">=20" (declared-support baseline, not an author preference) and every CI/release job configures node-version 22, so 22 is the CI-tested major and the preferred major; both satisfy the manifest constraint. Package manager: packageManager pnpm@11.8.0, used for development installs (pnpm install --frozen-lockfile) with the version read from package.json by pnpm/action-setup. Author DSH baseline: the plugin-mount lane pins @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.1 exactly, which is an author validation baseline distinct from the target host 0.2.0-rc.2. No overrides are evidenced (pnpm-workspace.yaml minimumReleaseAgeExclude is a pnpm setting, not an npm override). This recommendation is an inference from repository evidence and does not prove compatibility.

conclusion.statement: dsh-better-sidebar@0.24.1 (artifact sha256:46f313070857dce91da74440659d070a393df1152e0f6183bdcbff855f557fd2) was exercised on 8 cells across Node 20 and Node 22 against DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and the author-pinned baseline 0.2.0-rc.1. Web plane: on Node 22 the Web host mounted and the declared plugin client entry was published, fetched and materialized on BOTH DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.1 (result compatible, all stages runtime/artifact/profile/install/registration/host/surface/interaction/shutdown passed). On Node 20 the same Web cells failed at registration: DSH accepted the install command but the profile did not register dsh-better-sidebar, so host/surface/interaction/shutdown were skipped (surface-incompatible). Native cells: Node 20 install-failed on both DSH versions (install accepted, bundle not registered); Node 22 native cells are unknown, not failures - the exact artifact installed and loaded but dependency coverage is incomplete (16 missing Node peers, 0 indeterminate, 0 version facts, 3 unresolved edges). No adapter cells were scheduled. Net: the declared Web surface is demonstrated compatible on Node 22 (the CI-tested major and preferred major) against both the target host and the author baseline; Node 20 is not demonstrated for this plugin despite engines.node ">=20". This is a Radar smoke result, not a proof of consumer compatibility, and no authenticated or credentialed integration was exercised.
